title: Manager Career: a football manager/player career game built with Claude
author: Car1osMBb
selftext:
I built a full football career game with Claude, with a manager mode (transfers, contracts, wage budget, stadium) and a player mode (decisions in key match moments). Single HTML/JS file, no engine, fictional clubs and players, 6 languages.



Play it free in the browser: [https://playgama.ai/play/twr3ysrugtorj6](https://playgama.ai/play/twr3ysrugtorj6)



My workflow was one system at a time: I asked for a feature, tested it, reported bugs, and asked Claude to run its own test scripts before sending a new version. That kept regressions under control as the file grew.



Happy to share more about the process. Feedback on the game is welcome too.
